[Vocal: female alto, breathy conversational with occasional pitch instability, no heroic belts, deadpan with one cracked moment per section, slightly behind the beat, close-mic intimate, subtle vocal fry on phrase ends]

[Short Atmospheric Intro: 4 bars, guitar and room tone only]
[Breath]

[Verse 1: 12]
[Singing: hushed conversational, breathy, slightly behind the beat]
The window's open. It isn't helping.
My *collar's* wet at the back.
I made tea at nine.
It's still on the counter.

The fan turned itself off again.
I haven't gotten up.
There's a glass that someone left.
It's leaving a *ring*.

[Pre-Chorus: 8]
[Singing: lower, almost spoken, subtle vocal fry]
I had a thing I wanted to say at dinner.
I think it's in the laundry now.
I'll find it Tuesday.
Or I won't.

[Chorus: 10]
[Singing: breathy, pressed close to mic, no belt, voice held just below speaking volume]
[Doubled]
It gets behind my eyes
and *stays*.
Doesn't fall.
Doesn't —
Just sits there.
August in the room.
August on my skin.
I had a *sentence*.
I don't have it now.

[Verse 2: 12]
[Singing: same as Verse 1 but flatter, more detached]
You asked if I was fine.
I said the word back to you.
It came out *quiet*.
You didn't notice.

The ceiling has a stain I never saw.
Now I see it every morning.
My shirt is stuck along my *spine*.
I let it.

[Pre-Chorus 2: 8]
[Singing: even lower, edge of vocal fry]
I had a thing I wanted to say at dinner.
It went into the curtain.
The curtain keeps it now.
Fine.

[Chorus: 10]
[Singing: breathy, doubled, still no belt]
[Doubled]
It gets behind my eyes
and *stays*.
Doesn't fall.
Doesn't —
Just sits there.
August in the room.
August on my skin.
I had a *sentence*.
I don't have it now.

[Bridge: 12]
[Singing: voice attempts to break twice, both attempts collapse mid-phrase into breath, do not resolve to full belt, recover to whisper]
I was about to —
[Pause half bar]
*Nevermind*. I was —
[Pause half bar]
the word — the —

[Sudden Absolute Silence: 1 bar]

[Breath]

[Whispered]
nothing comes out.
nothing — *okay*.

[Pause half bar]

[Spoken, almost to self]
okay.
okay.

[Final Chorus: 14]
[Singing: lower in intensity not higher, voice melting downward, breath audible between phrases, no key lift, no climb]
[Doubled, second voice trailing half-beat behind]
It started at the *eye*.
Then down.
The shirt got it.
[Pause half bar]
Then the floor.
Whatever I had —
it's going the wrong way.

[Held note, voice tapering to breath]
I wasn't *angry*.
Maybe I was.
I don't know which one's true.
Neither one is true.

[Outro: 8]
[Singing: half-spoken, half-sung, dissolving]
[Breath]
The fan turned itself back on.

[Pause 1 bar]

[Breath]

I let it.

[Sudden Absolute Silence]

Blood. Sweat. Chalk. Dust.

cover.tags:
A fast, stylish, technical modern metal track, fused with Hard Rock. Aggressive, complex, sophisticated (NOT old or symphonic). The sound is driven by complex, aggressive, high-speed drum patterns (NOT simple on-beat), heavy, technical, fast-paced guitar riffs, and a prominent bassline. Subtle, "holy-sounding" choir/synth pads are layered under the aggressive metal. This is a duet for two distinct MALE vocalists with strictly separated roles:

[Male Vocal 1] (Verse/Pre-Chorus/Bridge ONLY):

Tone/Pitch: Melodic, clean, BRIGHT Hard Rock vocal (Mid-High Pitch / Tenor).

Delivery: Cold, detached, reverent, fanatical justification sung clearly over the high-speed music.

[Male Vocal 2] (Chorus ONLY):

Tone/Pitch: Deep, mature, LOW-PITCHED, aggressive voice.

Delivery: Explosive, powerful guttural GROWLS and LOW-PITCHED SCREAMS. Extremely cathartic and full of rage, directed outwards at enemies.

[Fast, complex drum fill and shredding guitar riff explode. Subtle "holy" choir pads swell underneath. ~15 seconds]

'축복 교본' 제 육육육장, 지금 시작한다!

[Fast, melodic, clean singing over the complex metal groove]

첫 번째 '은총'은 '정화'다. 타락한 영혼에겐 '자비'를.

흔들리는 신념이야말로, 가장 추악한 죄악이니!

고개는 숙여라! 두 손은 모아라! 심판은 빈틈없이!

[Pre-Chorus 1: Male Vocal 1]

[Building intensity, soaring melody]

그대의 심장에! 거룩한 빛을 내린다!

오차는 용납할 수 없다! 하나! 둘!

[Chorus 1: Male Vocal 2]

[Explosive 8-line Chorus. Aggressive growls/low-pitched shouts.]

거기 너! 무릎 꿇어라!

네놈들의 비명이 나를 깨운다!

모조리 짓밟아 주마!

이것이 나의 축제다!

전부 부숴버려!

흐트러진 구원 계획은, 파멸을 부르는 지름길이다!

자비는 공평하게! 심판은 신속하게!

왼손에 성서를! 오른손에 '자비'를!

오차는 용납할 수 없다! 셋! 넷!

[Chorus 2: Male Vocal 2]

[New 8-line Chorus. Aggressive growls/low-pitched shouts.]

거기 너! 아직 서 있나!

네놈들의 공포가 나를 채운다!

뼈와 살을 분리해 주마!

숨 쉴 틈도 없어! (RAAAAAGH!)

더 처절하게 빌어봐라!

전부 삼켜주마!

알겠나, 타락한 영혼들! 대답 소리가 작다!

cover.tags:
A dynamic Alternative/Hard Rock track. Features a dramatic call-and-response duet between TWO distinct male vocalists with clashing styles. Escalating office conflict.

Young Male Vocalist:

Vocal Tone: Light, youthful, unconcerned.

Vocal Style: Lazy, relaxed, sarcastic mid-to-low range, laid-back, bluesy sing-talk bored/hungover.

Music: Slow, groovy, laid-back Blues Rock or Stoner Rock.

Old Male Vocalist:

Vocal Tone: Deep, heavy, progressively furious.

Vocal Style: Aggressive, tense, powerful mid-to-high range shouting rap, building to primal scream climax. Frustration palpable.

Music: Fast, aggressive, driving Hard Rock or Punk Rock.

STRUCTURE:
Starts with Young Male Vocalists slow, lazy style.
Alternates and clashes sharply with Old Male Vocalists aggressive style, dramatic musical shifts. Intensity and Old Male Vocalists frustration build.
Climax: Old Male Vocalists ultimate primal scream + furious, chaotic guitar solo.
Ends abruptly, returning to Young Male Vocalists slow,
cover.lyrics:
[Young Male Vocal]
[Slow, bluesy guitar riff with lazy, light/youthful tone male vocal]
아... 머리 울려... 어제 마신 술이...
오늘 아침 햇살은... 왜 이리 눈부신지...
도대체 출근은... 왜 이리 빠른 건지... 아, 나른해...

[Old Male Vocal]
[Music shifts to fast, aggressive punk rock. Shouting, deep/heavy tone male vocal enters abruptly, frustration building]
술 타령이 나옵니까! 지금이 몇 시인데!
금고는 텅 비었고! 밀린 독촉 편지 산더미라고요!
보고서 마감 세 시간! 병력 보고는 엉망진창!
도대체! 대책이란 건 있습니까! 이대로 망할 겁니까!

[Chorus - Dramatic Clash]
[Music intensifies, light/youthful tone vocal clashes sharply with deep/heavy tone vocal]
[Young Male Vocal]
좀 천천히 해~ 너무 서두르면 체하는 법~ 어차피 내일의 태양은 뜨잖아~
[Old Male Vocal]
천천히 하면 다 망해! 내일이면 전부 끝장이야! 정신 차려 당장!
이 망할 성기사단, 내 피와 땀으로 지탱하는데!

[Young Male Vocal]
[Returns to slow, bluesy rock with lazy, light/youthful tone male vocal]
마을 경비대 항의? 늑대가 또 가축을... 그런 사소한 일까지...
내가 직접 나서야 하나... 잠시 명상으로... 해결책을... 음...

[Old Male Vocal]
[Returns to fast, aggressive hard rock. Shouting, deep/heavy tone male vocal's frustration builds, voice cracking]
사소한 일? 마을 유일한 식량원! 굶어 죽게 생겼다고!
명상할 시간에 칼이라도 닦아! 아니 삽이라도 들어!
기사단 평판 바닥 뚫고 지하까지 갈 겁니다! 이젠 정말 한계라고!

[Chorus - Building Intensity]
[Music crescendos, light/youthful tone vocal clashes with a more furious deep/heavy tone vocal]
[Young Male Vocal]
좀 쉬엄쉬엄 해~ 너무 힘 주면 빠지는 법~ 어차피 내일의 태양은 뜨잖아~
[Old Male Vocal]
쉬엄쉬엄하다 다 죽어! 내일이면 전부 끝장이야! 일 좀 하라고 당장!
제정신입니까! 당신 대체 뭐하는 양반이야!

[Young Male Vocal]
[Slightly more resigned slow, bluesy rock. Lazy, light/youthful tone male vocal complains softly]
아, 허리 아파... 낡은 의자가 불편해...
이럴 땐 역시... 강가에서 낚시나 가야 하는데...
자네도 같이 갈 텐가? 물고기가 많다더군...

[Old Male Vocal]
[Fast, aggressive hard rock. Shouting, deep/heavy tone male vocal, barely contained fury, stomping rhythm]
낚시요?! 지금 성벽 금 가고, 지붕에선 비가 샙니다!
식수원은 바싹 말랐고! 단원들은 썩은 감자로 연명하는데! 낚시요?!
당신이 대장이라고! 야이 책임감 없는 놈아!

[Bridge - Despair and Fury]
[Music fades to a pulsating, tense bass. Deep/heavy tone male vocal in a low, furious, almost desperate tone]
내가... 밤새도록... 곰팡이 핀 빵 씹어가며...
이 외상 장부를... 이 민원 서류를... 이 망할 기사단의 비극을...
혼자서 다... 혼자서 다 막고 있다고! 당신은 대체 뭘 한 거야!

[Climax - Explosive Release]
[Deep/heavy tone male vocal screams with ultimate, raw frustration. All instruments explode into a furious, chaotic, shredding guitar solo, pure unadulterated rage]
더는 못 참아!!! 이젠 정말 끝이다!!!

[Outro - Abrupt End]
[Music abruptly stops dead, then returns to slow, lazy intro riff with a light/youthful tone male vocal's final, nonchalant line]
...어, 이제 좀 조용하네.
그래서... 점심 뭐 먹을까?

create.lyrics:
[Intro]
I hereby submit my resignation, effective immediately
(Deep sigh)
Not again

[Verse 1]
Monday morning, wrote my final letter
Signed my name, thought things would get better
Then someone tried to heat their metal cup
In the microwave - the whole place blew up
Ran to fix the power, killed the flame
Came back up, my letter's not the same
Someone used it as a coffee filter
Now my dreams are nothing but bitter

[Pre-Chorus]
Every time I think I'm finally done
Another crisis has already begun
My blood pressure's through the ceiling tiles
This madness goes on for miles and miles

[Chorus]
I CAN'T QUIT! EVERY TIME I TRY TO QUIT!
SOMEONE FLOODS THE BATHROOM OR BREAKS THE PRINTER!
I CAN'T QUIT! WHY CAN'T I JUST QUIT?!
I SHOULD OPEN UP A BAKERY THIS WINTER!
I CAN'T LEAVE! EVEN WHEN I WANT TO LEAVE!
SOMEONE PAYS WITH BUTTONS FROM THEIR SLEEVE!
I CAN'T QUIT! I JUST CAN'T QUIT!
TWENTY YEARS OF CLEANING UP THIS SHIT!

[Verse 2]
Tuesday came, I tried it once again
Left the letter on his messy desk
Found him napping like a lazy hen
While the office turned into a wreck
Someone filed the reports by smell
Used a crayon on the balance sheet
The copy machine's gone to hell
My sanity admits defeat

[Bridge]
Maybe I should walk away
Find a quiet place to stay
Bake some bread by the sea
Live my life completely free
But who's gonna stop them from using glue as coffee?
Filing tax reports in bright pink marker?
DAMN IT, I CARE! THAT'S MY CURSE TO BEAR!

[Final Chorus]
I CAN'T QUIT! NO, I'LL NEVER QUIT!
TORE UP LETTER FIFTY-SEVEN, STAYING IN THIS PIT!
I CAN'T QUIT! MAYBE I DON'T WANT TO QUIT!
SOMEONE'S GOTTA KEEP THEM FROM LOSING THEIR SHIT!
I WON'T LEAVE! NO, I'LL NEVER LEAVE!
THIS MADHOUSE IS ALL I CAN BELIEVE!
I CAN'T QUIT! I WON'T QUIT!
TOMORROW'S JUST ANOTHER WORKING DAY!
WORKING DAY! WORKING DAY! MY BEAUTIFUL CURSE!

[Outro]
Sir! Someone faxed a sandwich!
Of course they did. I'm coming.

create.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Solo: Squeaky school recorder playing epic western melody]
[Instrumental: Mexican 12-string guitar tremolo + shamisen + modern trap drums + 808 bass, 16 counts]

[Verse 1]
[Singing: clear bright tone, precise Korean pronunciation, punchy rhythmic delivery]
다른 조직들과 겹치는 그날에 맞춰서,
[pause]
대중교통 끊긴 산골짜기 나와바리 끝.
미로 같은 집결지를 골랐지만,
[pause]
결국 냄새를 맡고 그들이 오고 있어.
등산복 입은 베테랑들,
차들의 행렬.

[Pre-Chorus]
[Singing: building tension, clear vocal delivery, shamisen riff intensifying]
신분을 확인하고,
뒤로 보내는 콜사인.
[pause]
정성껏 짜맞춘 대본을 쥐었지만,
이미 예감하고 있어,
찢겨나갈 거란 걸.

[Chorus]
[Singing: catchy melody hook, clear energetic vocal]
[Solo: Squeaky recorder counter-melody]
Alcohol Gun and Sushi
마이크 앞에 서는 순간부터 시작
Alcohol Gun and Sushi
살아남아도 결국 물리겠지

[Instrumental Break]
[Solo: Squeaky school recorder epic western theme with 808 bass]

[Verse 2]
[Singing: faster tight rhythmic flow, precise pronunciation, energetic delivery]
누군가 던진 불씨에,
들불처럼 번지는 목소리.
[pause]
꼬리를 무는 포화 속에,
타들어가는 각본.
[pause]
식은땀이 등줄기를 적셔도,
이 구역의 통들은 호락호락하지 않아.
[pause]
날아오는 칼날을 쳐내며,
여유를 가장하고,
가시지 않은 분노 위로,
억지 고개를 끄덕이지.
[pause]
믿음이란 포장지로 덮어둔,
불완전한 휴전.

[Pre-Chorus]
[Singing: rising tension, punchy straight delivery]
스피커를 찢을 듯이,
달아오르는 파열음.
[pause]
끝없이 쏟아지는,
날선 탄환들 속에서도,
[pause]
어떻게든 이 난장판에,
마침표를 찍어야 해.

[Chorus]
[Singing: full power catchy hook, all instruments explode]
[Solo: Squeaky recorder lead melody prominent]
Alcohol Gun and Sushi
애증의 문장들을 기록에 박아 넣고
Alcohol Gun and Sushi
살아남아도 결국 물리겠지

[Bridge]
[Singing: stripped back beat, clear conversational tone, precise diction]
사실 나도 물렸어,
잘한다 조금만.
[pause]
너무 아프지 않게 더 패라.
나한테 화풀이하지 않을만큼만.
[pause]
에헤이 좀더 패도돼 거기선.
[pause]
개같이 열심히는 하는데 어쩌겠수.
이바닥이 그렇게 녹녹치 않은걸.
[pause]
그 애증의 감정을,
덜 아프게 때려 넣으라고.

[Verse 3]
[Singing: beat pauses, acoustic guitar only, clear storytelling delivery]
유엔법이라는게,
조직에도 적용되는구나.
[pause]
그전에 그런게 있었구나.
시민감사조직이,
지켜보고 있구나.
[pause]
보스에게 존경한다면서,
내용은 그냥 욕이네.

[Bridge 2]
[Singing: clear conversational tone, punchy rhythmic delivery]
한 발의 총알만 쥔,
늙은 무법자들.
[pause]
뭐 선물같은거 없어?
그런거 안드립니다.
[pause]
아이 우산같은거 줘봐 좀.
그런거 없습니다.
[pause]
아이참 물이라도 줘,
내가 여기 단골인데.
[pause]
여깃습니다. 살펴가세요.

[Final Chorus]
[Singing: epic climax, clear euphoric vocal]
[Solo: Squeaky recorder heroic solo melody featured prominently]
Alcohol Gun and Sushi
세 번의 타격음으로 덮어버린 전쟁터
Alcohol Gun and Sushi
적군도 아군도 없이,
술과 스시로 씻어내

[Outro]
[Solo: Squeaky school recorder pathetic western melody fading]
[Instrumental: modern trap drums + shamisen fading, 16 counts]

create.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Bright Piano & Guitar Intro]

[Fast Tempo Start]

(Yeah!)

[Verse 1]

[Rhythmic Singing]

ちょっと待って、そこはトイレじゃない！

ただでさえ昨日、誰かがここでBBQしたせいで

油汚れが まだ落ちてないんだから (ベトベト！)

[Pre-Chorus]

[Soft and Cute]

大事な空洞に 毛糸玉なら許すけど

死んだネズミのコレクションはやめて

...あ、また「ニャー」って誤魔化す気？ (ズルい！)

[Chorus]

[Catchy Hook]

[Energetic J-Pop Melody]

ねえ、爪を立てないで ハートが響くから (痛いよ！)

君のせいで今日も 首が重たいわ

デコボコな二人で 散歩に出よう

すれ違う人が 振り返るけれど

ただの仲良しよ (たぶんね)

[Interlude]

[Piano Solo]

[Groovy Bass Line]

[Verse 2]

[Light and Bouncy]

星を数えて 詩を書きたいのに

狭い隙間で イビキかかないでよ

たまには磨いて ピカピカにして (キュッキュッ)

[Spoken Fast]

[Talking to oneself]

家賃… 違くて、友達料は『モフモフ』で… ってこれも変かな？

[Bridge]

[Music Lowers Volume]

[Curious Whispering]

他人が見たら ミステリーホラー？

[Calmly explaining]

いいえ、ここは 賑やかなワンルーム...

[Stop Music]

[Cute Angry Shout]

ちょっと！ シェアハウスじゃないって言ったでしょ！

[Guitar Solo]

[Fast Melodic Guitar Solo]

[Drums comeback loud]

[Chorus]

[Powerful Pop Rock]

ねえ、暴れないでよ バランス崩れる (おっとっと)

君がいないと 風通し良すぎるし

チグハグなリズムで 明日へ行こう

「ガオー」じゃないでしょ、「ごめんなさい」は？

まあ、可愛いから 仕方ないか

[Outro]

[Humming]

ふふ、今日は何して遊ぶ？

[Fade Out]

[End]

좋은 아침이야
새로운 시작이야
우리 함께

A gentle, smooth, and relaxing Easy Listening track with Bossa Nova and Light Jazz Pop influences. The music features a soft, swaying Bossa Nova rhythm, a smooth acoustic guitar or a clean electric guitar playing jazzy chords, a warm upright bass, and light, brushed drumming.
CRUCIAL: The entire song is performed by a single, versatile female vocalist with a soft, breathy, and consistently gentle voice (whisper-singing style). She must subtly shift her nuance for each persona:

For the Cat part, her voice is light, cute, and almost ASMR-like.

For the Dullahan part, her delivery becomes slightly more melodic, clear, and poetic, while remaining gentle.

For the Tiger part, her voice becomes a low, breathy, and purr-like whisper, like a big, sleepy cat.
The overall mood is witty, cheerful, fresh, and incredibly pleasant and relaxing.

The song incorporates elements of power metal and melodic death metal, with fast tempos and intricate guitar riffs. The vocal delivery is primarily clean, but with a raw, aggressive edge, occasionally transitioning into a more guttural style. The song structure includes distinct verse, pre-chorus, and chorus sections, with instrumental breaks showcasing guitar solos and rhythmic complexity. The production is tight and polished, with a clear separation of instruments and a powerful, impactful sound. The drums feature fast double bass drumming and intricate fills. The bass guitar provides a solid foundation, often mirroring the guitar riffs. The guitars utilize palm-muted chugging, fast tremolo picking, and melodic lead lines. The overall mood is intense and epic.

At the very end of Verse 1, a harsh and sudden sound effect (e.g., a distorted blast, a loud glitch) must violently interrupt the music. This is an abrupt cut, not a build-up, that launches the track directly into the first chorus.

Part 2 (Chorus Onward):
From the first chorus to the end, the style completely transforms into a sophisticated Nu Metal/Electronic Rock hybrid. The arrangement needs heavy distorted guitars, cinematic synths, and DJ scratches. A versatile male vocalist takes over for the rest of the song, performing rhythmic rapping, powerful melodic singing, and intense, emotional screaming as required by the song's sections. The mood becomes dark and energetic.

[Intro]
[Soft Electric Piano Building]

[Verse 1]
[Male Vocal: Laid-back Conversational Rap]
어제 쪽지 게임했지
하나씩 돌려가며 섞고 또 섞고
"하루종일 애교 부리기"
장난으로 적었는데
누가 뽑을까 했더니
표정 굳은 채로 펼쳐 보더니
아 이거 완전 대박

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal: Gritting Teeth, Forced]
종이 한 장 때문에
인생 끝난 기분이야
이 악물고 심호흡 크게 하고
"오빠 좋은 아침"
윽 소름 돋아
"커피 타드릴까요"
손발 오그라들어

[Pre-Chorus]
[Male Vocal: Teasing]
표정은 왜 그렇게 굳어있어
좀 더 자연스럽게 해봐
[Female Vocal: Struggling]
규칙은 규칙이니까
참고 해야지 하루만
[Duet]
거리는 좁혀지고
공기는 어색해져

[Chorus]
[Duet: Call-Response, Rhythmic]
툭툭 주고받는 말투 변해
정반대 텐션 따로 노는 분위기
[Female] "점심 뭐 드실래요 헤헤"
[Male] 잠깐만 이거 너무 어색해
어울릴 것 같지 않던
우리 둘의 대화가
어색함이 만든 이상한 리듬
억지로 하던 말투가
점점 더 자연스러워져 가네

[Verse 3]
[Female Vocal: Getting Natural]
점심 지나 오후쯤
어라 이상한데
생각보다 편해지네 이거 뭐야
손발 오글거림 이제 없어
자연스럽게 윙크까지 딱딱

[Verse 4]
[Male Vocal: Getting Nervous]
잠깐만 잠깐만
뭔가 이상해
장난이었는데 눈빛이 진지해져
설탕 덩어리 같아 너무 달콤해
등골이 서늘해져 식은땀 뻘뻘
언제 끝나지 이거

[Pre-Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal: Confident]
이제 좀 재밌어지는데
왜 이렇게 피하려고 해
[Male Vocal: Panicking]
약속 시간 지났잖아
12시 땡 쳤어
제발 그만해도 될 것 같은데
[Duet]
역전된 상황
뒤바뀐 입장

[Chorus 2]
[Duet: High Energy, Role Reversed]
딱딱 주고받는 말투 변해
완전 뒤바뀐 분위기 역전된 그림
[Female] "어디 가요 같이 놀아요"
[Male] 도망가고 싶어 살려줘
멈출 줄 모르는 끝없는 대화
쫓고 쫓기는 이상한 리듬
장난으로 시작한 이 게임이
멈출 생각 없어 보이네 계속

[Bridge]
[Male Vocal: Desperate]
하루 지났는데
왜 아직도
집에 가고 싶어
[Female Vocal: Sweet]
재밌잖아
내일도 할까
모레도 글피도
[Duet: Building]
소원 한 줄이 만든
끝나지 않는 이야기

[Final Chorus]
[Duet: Settled]
톡톡 주고받는 말투 변해
이제 익숙해진 이 분위기
[Female] "오빠 이제 자연스럽죠"
[Male] 체념 이게 일상이 됐네
예상 못한 자연스러운 대화
어색함이 만든 완벽한 리듬
소원 쪽지 하나로 시작된
새로운 우리만의 일상

[Outro]
[Female Vocal: Satisfied]
내일도 좋은 하루 되세요
[Male Vocal: Resigned]
알겠어 또 내일 봐
[Duet]
쪽지 게임은 끝나지 않아

A groovy, sophisticated, and funky modern Korean Hip-Hop track.

The beat is upbeat and danceable, but not a simple club track. It's built on a live, funky bassline, a tight, groovy drum pattern, and soulful electric piano chords (Rhodes). A clean, funky guitar plays catchy licks and riffs.

CRUCIAL for the male vocal: The vocal is a rhythmic, storytelling rap with a sharp and clear accent. The flow is tight and syncopated, playfully pushing and pulling against the groovy beat. His delivery is confident and witty, with a cynical, 'badass' charm, but also capable of expressing moments of frustration and intrigue.

아, 젠장, 머리 아프게, 왜 자꾸 네가 거슬려!

'엮이기 싫다'고 돌아서면, 또 네 생각이 나고!
아, 진짜 돌아버리겠네! 너란 여자, 대체 뭐냐고!

근데 '고맙다'는 그 한마디, 그 붉어진 얼굴

...재밌네, 이거. 좋아. 판을 새로 짜지. 딱 기다려.

[Final Chorus]
아, 젠장, 머리 아프다고! 자꾸 네가 거슬린다고!
그깟 철벽, 조만간에 내가 다 뚫어버릴 테니까!
'엮이기 싫다'고 돌아서도, 결국엔 네 생각뿐이고!
아, 진짜 돌아버리겠네! 너란 여자, 이제 내 거 하자고!

[Instrumental: Turntable scratch + fuzz guitar + big beat 8 bars]

[Verse 1]
[Singing: Mid-high scratchy tone, confident calculated precision, grunge sing-rap]
시선 하나 던졌는데 네가 살짝 웃어넘겨
흥미로운데 이 친구 생각보다 만만치 않아
저기 저 녀석들 봐 말도 못 걸고 쳐다만 보잖아
"저것들보단 내가 낫지?" 귀에 대고 속삭여

잔 비우는 속도 체크 다음 한 잔 타이밍 재고
손가락이 테이블 톡톡 리듬 타면 흥미 있다는 신호
"혼자 왔어?" 뻔한 질문에 눈썹만 까딱거리지
대답 대신 미소로 넘기는 거 뭐 당연한 거겠지

[Pre-Chorus]
[Singing: Rising tension, dangerous whisper, laid-back groove]
핸드폰 뒤집어놨네 집중하겠다는 무언의 사인
"한 잔 더?" No면 끝 Yes면 연장전 시작
바텐더 눈치 주며 타이밍 재고 있어
방해꾼들 다 사라졌어 본론 들어가자

[Chorus]
[Singing: Bright energetic explosive, scratchy melodic delivery]
Deal With Me 선택지는 딱 두 개뿐이야
지루하게 끝나거나 나랑 위험하게 가거나
All In Tonight 안 걸면 그냥 구경만 하는 거지
이 자리 뜨는 순간 기회는 바로 날아가

한마디로 심장 박동 올려놓고
네가 다음 말 꺼낼 때까지 기다려줄게
Deal With Me 아직 승부는 안 났잖아
정답 없는 게임이야 같이 배워보자

[Verse 2]
[Singing: Cold calculated precision, grunge sing-rap, reading micro-signals]
"화장실 좀" 자리 뜨는 순간 카운트 시작해
3분 넘으면 도망각 2분이면 아직 고민 중
딱 1분 30초 돌아오네 마음 정했다는 뜻
립스틱 고쳤네 이건 확정 신호잖아

"나갈까?" 던지기 전에 코트 먼저 챙겨 들고
"어디?" 물으면 "가면 알아" 미소만 남겨둬
궁금해서 미치겠지? 그 표정이 딱 좋아
답 안 주고 그냥 일어나 문 쪽으로 걸어가

[Bridge]
[Singing: Laid-back cynical tone, tsundere attitude]
뭐 패는 이미 다 까졌고 숨길 것도 없잖아
더 끌면 재미없어 지금 아니면 못 하는 거
집에 갈래 아님 나랑 밤새 돌아다닐래
Deal With Me 한 번만 말해봐

[Final Chorus]
[Singing: Triumphant resolution, explosive energy, scratchy melodic]
Deal With Me 선택지는 딱 두 개뿐이야
지루하게 끝나거나 나랑 위험하게 가거나
All In Tonight 이미 네 눈빛이 답을 했어
말로는 고민하는 척 발은 문 쪽으로 향해

서명 따윈 필요 없어 눈빛으로 다 끝났잖아
이 손을 잡는 순간 게임은 이미 끝난 거야
Deal With Me 따라올지는 네 맘이야
난 먼저 나갈게 밖에서 보자

[Outro]
[Instrumental: Calculated dissonance fade to silence]

[Instrumental: subtle ambient cafe texture, 140 BPM, airy Rhodes piano, crisp UKG 2-step beat]

날씨 좋다. 그치? 
Look at me.

[Singing: light airy sing-talk, bouncy staccato delivery, syncopated flow]

살짝 부는 breeze. Nice.

근데 네 시선, skip-skip left.

No, baby. Eyes on mine. 

[Pre-Chorus 8] 
[Singing: sweetness gradually fading, building tension, dry tone] 
톡톡. Ice cup. 
뚝뚝. Water drop.

[Sudden Absolute Silence: 0.5 seconds]

Breathe with me. 

[Chorus 16] 
[Beat: SUDDEN HALF-TIME DROP 70 BPM, heavy 808 sub-bass, metallic industrial stabs] 
[Singing: cold deadpan chant, flat-affect, robotic precision, no emotion] 
Look. At. Me. Only me. 
눈빛 lock. Don't blink. 
Focus. Here. Stay with me.

바깥 소린 다 black out.

예쁘게 웃어줄 때 잘해. 
[Singing: cold deadpan chant] 
Look. At. Me. Only me. 

[Post-Chorus 8]

[Singing: syncopated staccato syllables] 
(Look) (at) (me) 
(Mi-mi-mine) 
(Black) (out) 
[Singing: sweet smile-in-voice]

[Verse 2 16] 
[Singing: bubblegum tone completely returns, breezy and light, like nothing happened]

단 거 좋아해. I know, right? 
표정 왜 그래? Pale-pale face.

[Pause half bar] 
방금 나, 좀 scary? 
아냐 baby. Laugh for me. 
앞머리 삐죽. Fix it please. 
Right here. Stay with me. 

[Pre-Chorus 2 8] 
[Singing: delicate but eerie, tight phrasing, cold eyes texture] 
얼음 녹아. Time to leave. 
내 손 위에 네 손. Click. 
오늘따라 얌전해. 
옆에 딱. Close to me. 
길 잃으면 안 되지. 
...알지? 

[Chorus 2 16] 
[Beat: HALF-TIME DROP 70 BPM, massive distortion on bass, wide stereo] 
[Singing: maximum deadpan, Doubled, cold and dominant] 
Look. At. Me. Only me. 
눈빛 lock. Don't blink. 
Focus. Here. Stay with me. 
Mine. Mine. Mine. 너는 mine. 
바깥 소린 다 black out. 
[Singing: dry close-mic whisper] 
어디도 못 가, 절대. 
[Singing: cold deadpan chant] 
Look. At. Me. Only me. 

[Bridge 8] 
[Sudden Absolute Silence: 1 bar full band cut] 
[Singing: dry close-mic whisper, hyper-intimate and unsettling] 
Don't ever make me jealous. 
속으로 무슨 생각 하는지. 다 보여. 
그런 표정. Cute. 
근데 조금 dangerous. 
You're my beautiful boy. 
예쁜 말만 해줘. 
한 번 더. 
Only me. 

[Final Chorus 16] 
[Beat: 70 BPM extreme heavy anti-drop, industrial texture] 
[Singing: maximum deadpan, Doubled, Harmony +3rd] 
Look. At. Me. Only me. 
눈빛 lock. Don't blink. 
Focus. Here. Stay with me. 
Mine. Mine. Mine. 너는 mine. 
바깥 소린 다 black out. 
[Singing: dry close-mic whisper] 
숨도 내 박자에 맞춰. 
[Singing: cold deadpan chant] 
Look. At. Me. Only me. 

[Outro 8] 
[Beat: 140 BPM returns softly, ambient cafe texture fades back in] 
[Singing: sweet conversational tone, completely normal again] 
다음엔 저 골목 갈까? 
어? 오빠, 대답 안 해? 
[Sudden Absolute Silence: 0.5 seconds] 
[Singing: deadpan whisper] 
Answer me. 
[Singing: sweet smile-in-voice] 
Good boy.

[Intro: Music box melody, ethereal synth pad, vinyl crackle]
[Singing: sweet light airy, fairytale storytelling, whisper]
깊은 숲속 길을 잃은 예쁜 왕자님

[Verse 1]

[Singing: dry close-mic whisper, very intimate]

[Chorus]

바깥은 너무 춥고 어두운걸요
여기 성 안이 제일 따뜻하잖아
가시덤불이 성벽을 포근히 감싸줄 테니
아무 걱정 말고 가만히 눈을 감아

[Interlude]
[Glitch FX, microtonal string glissando, heavy 2-step groove]

[Verse 2]
[Beat: sparse, tense]
[Singing: soft but slightly darker tone]

혹시 저 멀리 숲의 끝을 그리는 걸까
안 돼, 밖은 아주 무서운 괴물이 살지
공주님이 지켜줄 텐데, 떨지 않아도 돼

[Bridge]
[Rhythmic tension building, discordant piano chords]
자꾸만 닫힌 문을 쳐다보는 젖은 두 눈
공주를 두고 어디로 가고 싶은 걸까
우리의 성은 이렇게 완벽한데
왕자가 공주만 바라보면 좋을 텐데

[Build-up]
[Vinyl scratch, sudden heavy glitch, string tension peak]
[Singing: dry whisper, chilling]
쉬이... 깰라.

[Final Chorus]
[Explosive Energy: Massive sub-bass, frantic 2-step beat, soaring strings]
어디 못 가게 유리구두는 예쁘게 숨겨둘게
저기 파랑새는 다치지 않게 고운 새장에 모셔둘게
동화는 무조건 해피엔딩이어야 하잖아
그치? 울지 마, 예쁘게 웃는 게 훨씬 좋아

[Outro]
[Beat drops out abruptly, eerie music box fades, long reverb]
[Singing: sweet delicate whisper]
그럼, 잘 자.

create.tags:
Bright airy summer dance-pop, princess fairytale crystalline
melody, 160 BPM with sudden half-time 80 BPM chorus drop, minor
verse lifting to chorus. Female lead, high airy soprano, sweet
playful princessy delivery, pouty cute character, light and cool
not warm, every line sung melodically on pitch never spoken.
Verse: bouncy 2-step skip groove, melodic phrasing alternating
long playful drawn-out lines with short pouty jabs. Pre-chorus
tightens then a hard stop into the drop. Chorus: half-time, wide
glassy fairytale hook, sustained bright airy vowels, three
choruses building progressively closer and more intense. Verse 2
same skip groove, pleased clinging tone. Instrumental drop break,
no vocal. Bridge: one passage softens into tender ballad warmth
then snaps back cold within the section. Microtonal touch,
occasional quarter-tone pitch bend on held vocal notes, slightly
off and uncanny. Mood: cool refreshing summer, cute push-pull,
playful but something unreadable underneath.

Move, just move

Two more blocks, two more breaths

Message in my pocket pressing through the cotton
Heavy in a way nothing else is

Move, just move

[Singing: stripped, intimate]
[Drums cut]

What I left, I left it there
Sun's coming for me anyway
What I left, I left it there
Sun's coming for me anyway

Sun's coming, sun's coming
Sun's coming for me anyway

[Drums cut]

[Intro]

(School Bell rings echoing: Ding... Dong... Dang... Dong...)

(Sound of a pencil snapping)Class dismissed.

(Distorted Guitar Feedback rises)

(Drum Fill: Du-du-du-du-Bam!)

[Verse 1]

Sitting in the back row, staring at the wall

Waiting for the signal, waiting for the call

Uniform is tight, but my knuckles are itching

Tired of the silence, tired of the preaching

Check the clock, tick-tock, counting down the seconds

My body is a weapon, and the shadow beckons

Tie is loose, sleeves rolled up high

Ready to explode, ready to fly

[Pre-Chorus]

They think I’m just a girl with a pretty face

Until I put them in their proper place

Adrenaline spiking, entering the zone

This is the only world I’ve ever known

[Chorus]

This is my battleground, this is my school!

Breaking every limit, breaking every rule!

Left hook, right hook, watch me ignite!

I am the main character of this night!

Boom! Boom! Knock you down!

I’m the queen of this town!

(Guitar Riff - Heavy & Fast)

[Verse 2]

(Bass driving hard)

No more homework, just heavy bag work

Punching through the doubt, wiping off the smirk

Sambo style, grab and smash, knee to the core

Make the concrete tremble, shaking up the floor

I don’t need a savior, I don’t need a knight

I am the darkness and I am the light

One, two, three, four, hit it with the beat

Victory tastes like sweat, oh so sweet

[Chorus]

This is my battleground, this is my school!

Breaking every limit, breaking every rule!

Left hook, right hook, watch me ignite!

I am the main character of this night!

Boom! Boom! Knock you down!

I’m the queen of this town!

[Bridge: Slow Motion Action]

(Music slows down - Orchestral Stabs & Heavy Breathing)Focus.Target locked.Breathe in.Full power.3... 2... 1...SCREAM! (Shouting: YAAAH!)

[Guitar Solo]

[Final Chorus]

This is my battleground, this is my school!

(Explosive Energy)

Breaking every limit, breaking every rule!

Left hook, right hook, watch me ignite!

I am the main character of this night!

Nothing can stop me, I’m combat high!

Watch me burn the sky!

[Outro]

(Heavy Breathing)

(School Bell rings again: Ding... Dong...)Dismissed.

[Verse 1]
[Singing: Curious observant tone, natural conversational]
영하 10도 표정으로
다들 널 피해 다녀
겨울왕국 그 자체라며
근데 난 다 봤어

패딩 주머니 속에 숨긴
따뜻한 핫팩 하나
무심하게 툭 건네주던
그 손의 온도까지

[Pre-Chorus]
[Singing: Rising excitement, smooth legato]
겉은 시베리아 한복판
속은 적도 부근이야
이 온도차에 감기 걸려도
난 너한테 뛰어들래

[Chorus/Drop]
[Singing: Explosive energy, addictive hook]
Winter rush 멈출 수 없어
얼음 속 봄을 찾아
Winter rush 숨이 차도
녹여버릴 거야 다
차가운 눈빛 뒤에 숨겨둔
너만의 봄날을 내가 가질래
Winter rush rush rush

[Verse 2]
[Singing: Faster, more confident playful]
일교차가 너무 심해
낮엔 봄이고 밤엔 겨울
너랑 똑같아 헷갈려
그래서 더 미치겠어

"별로 안 춥던데" 하면서
내 손 꽉 잡는 거 뭔데
철벽 치는 그 말투도
다 녹고 있는 거 맞지?

[Pre-Chorus]
[Singing: Playful teasing rising tension]
북풍 불다 남풍 불고
네 마음도 왔다 갔다 해
차가운 겉모습 뒤에
봄날 같은 속마음 숨겼어

[Chorus/Drop]
[Singing: Maximum energy, full arrangement]
Winter rush 멈출 수 없어
얼음 속 봄을 찾아
Winter rush 숨이 차도
녹여버릴 거야 다
차가운 눈빛 뒤에 숨겨둔
너만의 봄날을 내가 가질래
Winter rush rush rush

[Breakdown]
[Drums drop, only bass + warm ambient]
[Singing: Soft vulnerable realization]
얼음이 녹으면 뭐가 될까
물이 아니야 봄이 돼
너처럼 그렇게

[Build-Up]
[Singing: Determination rising to energy]
이제 숨기지 마
다 들켰으니까
그 따뜻한 봄
나한테만 보여줘

[Final Drop]
[Singing: Triumphant energetic climax]
Winter rush 멈추지 않아
봄은 이미 왔어
Winter rush 네 품속에
완전히 녹아내려
차가운 계절 끝에 찾아낸
우리만의 봄날이 시작됐어
Winter rush rush rush

[Outro]
[Drums maintain energy, warm spring atmosphere]
[Singing: Confident bright ending]
내 맘 훔쳐간
거짓말쟁이!
봄 도둑!

Blow the speakers out till the dawn.
Sorry not sorry, 'cause Sam is gone.

[Vocal chops: heavily stylized, chopped and screwed]
[Deep house beat driving]
Sam is gone. (Bounce.)
Sam is gone. (Yeah.)

[Verse 2]
[Bass drops out, snaps only]
[Singing: cool, effortless delivery]
Downstairs is clear.
Crossed the sea.
Push the red light.
Wild and free.

(Ooh-ooh) No one is knocking.

Watch us fly.

Whole squad and the moon on our side.
Blow the speakers out till the dawn.
Sorry not sorry, 'cause Sam is gone.

[Outro]
[Fading deep house groove, minimalist]
(Bounce.)
Sam is gone.
[Sudden stop]

create.lyrics:
[Intro: High-speed 16th-note hi-hats, swirling frantic synth arpeggios, heavy guitar feedback]
[Singing: slow, heavy, lingering on each word, keeping breathless tension]

[Verse 1]
[Singing: slow legato melody, contrast with fast backing]
눈가에 아린 뜨거운 붉음이
뺨에 어린 차가운 하양을 물들여
아려오다 붉게 달아올라 피어날 때
흐려지게 차오르는 뜨거움이 번져내려

[Pre-Chorus]
[Singing: melodic lines stretched out, while drums double-time]
천천히 딛는 걸음 위로 짙게 흩어지는 하얀 숨
가만히 걷는 가슴에 터질 듯 시린 냉기가 차올라
허공을 휘젓던 뿌연 안개가 얼굴 위로 엉겨 붙고
무게 없는 조각 하나 뺨에 닿는 찰나조차 아파와

[Chorus]
[Singing: explosive slow-burning shout, powerful long notes]
[Energy: Explosive][Full Mix]
제자리를 맴돌며 온 세상이 내게 세치우는 밤!
새하얀 입김이 붉어진 시야를 매섭게 덮치고
조용한 어둠마저 날카로운 파편이 되어 쏟아져
질식할 듯 부풀어 오른 호흡을 길바닥에 토해낸
서늘하고 뜨거운 이 감각의 한가운데

[Verse 2]
[Singing: calm and steady over chaotic instrumentation]
노란 불빛이 휘젓는 파동 사이로
발을 떼지 못한 채로 밀려가는 찰나
가만히 내뱉은 숨이 안개가 되어
다시 나를 덮쳐오는 하얀 밤의 질식

[Bridge]
[Singing: suffocating intensity, sustained notes over rapid drums]
[Stripped Back]
삼켜낸 냉기가 가슴을 헤집고
토해낸 온기가 다시 목을 조여와
눈을 감아도 선명하게 난타하는
붉고 하얀 감각의 폭풍

[Chorus]
[Callback: Chorus melody]
[Singing: absolute emotional peak, tearing vocal cords, long sustained belts]
[Energy: Explosive][Full Mix]
제자리를 맴돌며 온 세상이 내게 세치우는 밤!
새하얀 입김이 붉어진 시야를 매섭게 덮치고
조용한 어둠마저 날카로운 파편이 되어 쏟아져
질식할 듯 부풀어 오른 호흡을 길바닥에 토해낸
서늘하고 뜨거운 이 감각의 한가운데

[Outro: Synth and drums peak and suddenly cut to wind noise]
[Singing: slow, fading whisper]
얼어붙은 뺨 위로 흩어지는 뜨거움
고요하게 젖어드는
세치우는 밤

create.tags: Brazilian Phonk, Funk Mandelão, High BPM, Female Vocals, Heavy Distorted 808 Bass, Syncopated Rhythm, Tubular Bells Phonk Rhythm, Antique Clock Chimes, Detuned Solo Cello, Screeching Violin, Distorted Harpsichord, Gun Reload Foley, Sword Shing SFX, Heavy Vinyl Crackle, Old LP Noise, Wow and Flutter, Glitchy Texture, Dark Orchestral, Horrorcore, Industrial, Manic Laughter, Whispering ASMR, Cinematic Build-up, Hard-hitting Drop, Dynamic Structure
create.lyrics:
[Extended Intro - Vinyl Crackle & Cello Solo]
[Let the music build up slowly with heavy static noise]
[A lone, detuned cello plays a sad melody for 20 seconds]

[Verse 1 - Slow & Eerie]
A sombra me devora
[Short Instrumental - Glitchy Violin]
[Violin screeches suddenly]
Quebra a cara, lixo
[Sound FX - Gun Cocking]
[Chk-Chk sound]
Doce valsa maldita
[Bass Fill - Deep Rumble]
[Sub-bass wobbles heavily]
Vem pro dono, agora

[Pre-Chorus - Rising Tension]
[Drums getting faster and faster]
Agora... Agora...
[Tubular Bell Strike]
[Dong! Dong!]
Lixo... Lixo...

[Drop - Heavy Bass & Tubular Bells]
[Instrumental Phonk Drop - No Vocals]
[Aggressive "Doom-Cha-Cha" rhythm with Church Bells]
[Keep the beat going for 20 seconds]

[Vocal Chop Loop]
Quebra-Quebra-Quebra-Quebra
[Sound FX - Sword Shing]
Lixo-Lixo-Lixo-Lixo

[Long Instrumental Break - Broken Orchestra]
[Music slows down momentarily]
[Vinyl crackle becomes very loud]
[Distorted Harpsichord melody plays]

[Verse 2 - Aggressive]
O tempo se evapora
[Silence - Abrupt Stop]
[Music stops for 1 second]
Cala a boca, lixo
[Explosion FX]
[Bass kick hits hard]
Minha boneca aflita
[Instrumental - Creepy High Synth]
[High pitched sine wave sound]
Olha pra mim, agora

[Build Up - Maximum Pressure]
Olha pra mim!
[Snare Roll]
[Drrrrat!]
Olha pra mim!

[Drop 2 - Explosive Bass]
[Full Power Instrumental Drop]
[Heavy 808 Bass booming louder than before]
[Glitch effects on the rhythm]

[Bridge - Slow & Creepy ASMR]
[Music slows down significantly, tempo drops]
[Only breathing sounds and static]
Minha boneca aflita...
[Whisper Echo]
[Aflita... Aflita...]
É tudo meu...

[Verse 3 - Climax]
A gaiola te adora
[Sound FX - Cage Door Slam]
[Metal clanking sound]
Senta e chora, lixo
[Bass Slide Down]
[Bwoooooong]
Essa dor é bonita
[Manic Laughter]
[Hahaha...]
É tudo meu, agora

[Final Drop - Maximum Chaos]
[Aggressive Phonk Beat with everything overlapping]
Senta e chora!
É tudo meu!

[Extended Outro - Fading Cello]
[Beat stops abruptly]
[Only static noise and cello remains]
A sombra me devora...
[Fade out slowly]
